nom: Eucerin Radiant Tone Daily Face Lotion SPF 30 Dark Spot Corrector

segments.oily: Reviewers with oily or combination-to-oily skin generally report the lotion absorbs well and does not feel greasy, with one calling it wonderful for oily skin and another using it successfully in place of oily sunscreen-foundations, though one oily/acne-prone reviewer found it too thick/heavy and broke out.
segments.dry: The few reviewers mentioning dryness describe the lotion as hydrating and note it does not leave skin feeling dry or tight.
segments.combination: A reviewer with combination skin (described as going from dry to oily across the face) reports the product balanced her skin and helped her dark spots with no breakouts.
segments.sensitive: Reviewers who identify as sensitive report mixed results: several say it did not irritate or sting their skin and is fine even with rosacea, but others with sensitive skin report stinging eyes, burning, or breakouts from the fragrance and texture.
segments.mature: One reviewer in her 40s frames the SPF as important skin-aging protection but does not report a visible anti-aging effect beyond sun protection.

concerns.aging: One reviewer over 40 values the SPF for long-term skin protection but does not describe visible anti-aging change; another mentions seeing a difference in fine lines around the eyes after a few uses.
concerns.dehydration: Most reviewers describe the product as hydrating, moisturizing, and leaving skin feeling plump or soft, with several explicitly praising the moisture without greasiness; one reviewer felt it was not moisturizing enough for her skin.
concerns.redness: Two reviewers report reduced redness or improvement in skin that was previously red, and one felt it naturally camouflaged redder spots, though this is only mentioned by a small number of reviewers.
concerns.barrier: There is little direct comment on barrier function; a few reviewers mention peeling or stinging on first uses that later stopped, suggesting some initial irritation for a minority.
concerns.spots: Many reviewers report visible fading or lightening of dark spots, sun spots, melasma, or post-acne marks within weeks to a month of consistent use, but a substantial minority (including a dermatologist-supervised six-month user) report no visible change at all.
concerns.blemishes: Reports are split: some acne-prone reviewers say it reduced acne scarring, post-acne inflammation and pigmentation with no new breakouts, while others with acne-prone or oily skin report clogged pores and new breakouts, one describing them as increasing over weeks.
concerns.oiliness: Reviewers with oily skin mostly report the lotion feels lightweight and non-greasy despite looking slightly greasy in the bottle, with no reports of increased oiliness on the skin itself.

aspects.libelle: No visible dark-spot improvement despite prolonged use

extraits.texte: I appreciate being selected to try this product but I was not a fan of it. It was too thick/heavy for my skin, ( I have acne, oily skin so I'm very careful if a product is too heavy for my skin because it will within a couple days break me out ) I tried to use this product for a month to be able to give a thorough review but I started getting breakouts so I thought maybe 2 weeks? But the breakouts started becoming more & more & also it's heavily fragrance in my opinion & I don't like fragrance in my skincare ( I can do earthy, herbal, oats, etc but I prefer fragrance free, this one smells like straight florals ), the good thing is the scent did faint within a couple hours, I wanted to see if it helps with my dark spot since it says it's geared towards that but because of the breakouts & the scent I couldn't continue using it & ended up gifting to my mom who don't have a sensitive skin like mine & also I didn't feel it was moisturizing.

Dermatologist recommended Radiant Tone for facial dark spot and I have used all three products, Radiant tone SPF day cream, Night Cream and Serum consistently, 2-3 times daily for six months and can see little if any change. Very disappointed in these products. Should I not see some improvement by now?

Having both severely oily skin and moderate to severe rosacea makes it somewhat difficult to find an appropriate sunscreen. I bought this on a whim and must say I am very pleased. No added irritation and works fine under both powder and balm foundation. Took off one star for heavy fragrance (why do they put fragrance in any skincare?). I have not used it long enough to see if it decreases any discoloration but I'm content to just use it for sunscreen purposes.

I struggle with acne and combo skin. literally from Sahara to oil city. I have a lot of dark spots from previous acne. I have tried creams and spot treatments specifically for dark spots and nothing has worked like this cream has. I have currently no breakouts and my skin is a lot more balanced. This has been a god send I am so thankful. And I have used it at night time and morning with no problem what so ever.

This has been amazing at quickly healing/reducing the post acne inflammation and pigmentation I tend to get because I can't leave it alone. Better than anything else I've tried. That Thiamidol is the real deal. Old marks fading within a week (using 3x/day) and new spots are barely getting a chance to stick around. But wow is this aggressively scented and I'm not one to be sensitive to fragrance or care if something is scented. It fades eventually but its a bit much.
This helps my acne scars fade quickly. I have sensitive skin and this doesnt irritate me. It also doesnt pill or cake under my makeup.

After washing my face with cleansing foam, I then clean it again with toner and then apply Eucerin sunscreen, which for me is the best, it leaves my skin dry all day long. Before, my skin was very red when I started using it, it improved.
